module.title: Audit, Provenance and Version Histories
module.business_purpose: Complements diagram_10_audit with history and append-only evidence for patient identity, workforce assignments, facilities, diagnostic assets, public profiles and moderation. Immutable clinical-note/file versions do not need snapshot history; their creation and access remain audited.
